integrity: The two standalone Python programs enumerate all candidate subsets through cardinality five, all minimum-state pairs, and all shortest-path sources. Results are reproducible by executing the embedded programs; no independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact theorem for the Petersen line graph, with two independently constructed exhaustive standard-library checkers. No general infinite-family assertion; historical equivalent under alternative terminology remains possible. Independent scholarly audit not performed.
title: Petersen edge-location-domination: ten complete-bipartite obstructions to geodesic exchanges
